Although I am a pious man, I am not the less a man.

Le Tartuffe.
 Act iii. Sc. 3
.

Molière

Harvard Classics, Vol. 26, Part 4

Tartuffe; Or, The Hypocrite

Jean Baptiste Poquelin Molière

Tartuffe, a religious hypocrite, tries to get title to his friend’s estate by sending him to jail. So effective was Molière’s satire, that the word 
tartuffe
 has become part of the English language.
